motifcode.execution: `motif "<task>"` one-shot, in the directory the runner gives it; a task ends only by a `done` call, which is challenged once and must be confirmed; a turn without an action is handed back; turn limit from the manifest (100).
motifcode.tools: done, bash (120 s per command unless the model sets another), read, write, apply_patch, term, skill, task; no MCP servers, no web tools.
motifcode.context: Frozen tool order; the model's reasoning is sent back every turn; compaction at 75% of the 262,144-token window; output cap per step from the manifest.
motifcode.scheduling: One agent; subagents through the task tool.
motifcode.observability: Journal of events, checkpoints and per-request usage; the runner keeps it with the patch and both grades.
motifcode.verification: The done-confirmation challenge; every turn's actions validated against closed schemas before any runs; a loop guard.
motifcode.governance: Streams every request; retries a failed or cut-off request up to six times; the API key is withheld from the commands the agent runs.

codex.execution: `codex exec` in the row's directory, approvals never, sandbox bypassed; no turn limit; the feedback round is `codex exec resume <thread>`.
codex.tools: Codex's own: shell commands, apply_patch, plan updates; no web search configured.
codex.observability: `--json` event log (commands, messages, usage per turn); the cap proxy logs one line per request.
codex.governance: Per-row CODEX_HOME from a pristine config; stream idle timeout raised to 30 minutes; the output cap added per request by adapters/cap_proxy.mjs (CODEX_STOCK=1 runs without it).

opencode.execution: `opencode run --pure` in the row's directory, permissions auto-approved; no turn limit; the feedback round is `opencode run --session <id>`.
opencode.tools: OpenCode's own: bash, read, edit, write, glob, grep, todowrite, task; webfetch and websearch denied by config.
opencode.context: limit.context 262,144; limit.output set to the manifest's cap in a per-row config.
opencode.scheduling: One agent; subagents through its task tool.
opencode.observability: `--format json` event log (tool calls, tokens per step).
opencode.governance: Per-row XDG config, data and state directories; no external plugins.
